relationships.subject: paeoniflorin
relationships.evidence_quote: Paeoniflorin alleviated mechanical abnormal pain, decreased levels of ionized calcium binding adapter molecule-1 (Iba-1), glial fibrillary acidic protein, Heat Shock Protein 90 Alpha Family Class A Member 1 (HSP90AA1, inflammatory factor) and High Mobility Group Box 1 (HMGB1, inflammation-related protein)

relationships.subject: HSP90AA1
relationships.evidence_quote: HSP90AA1 overexpression reversed the effects of paeoniflorin on HMGB1 expression and inflammatory factors and proteins in mouse astrocytes co-cultured with exosome

key_findings: Paeoniflorin alleviates CCI neuropathic pain and glial activation via HSP90AA1/HMGB1.
BV-2 exosomes are taken up by astrocytes, mediating microglia-astrocyte crosstalk.
